info.title: etwrelay
info.description: Optional companion tool for etwutils: reads raw ETW relay frames from stdin and delivers them to an OpenTelemetry decoding gateway as OTLP/HTTP logs.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Reads raw ETW relay frames (from 'etwutils realtime --format relay') and delivers them to an OpenTelemetry decoding gateway as OTLP/HTTP logs.
Exit codes: 0 delivered, 1 delivery failed, 2 invalid usage or input.

options.name: --endpoint
options.description: Base URL of the OTLP/HTTP gateway; '/v1/logs' is appended unless already present. [default: http://localhost:4318]

options.name: --input-format
options.description: How frames arrive: 'binary' (default, concatenated frames, for 'etwutils realtime --format relay') or 'base64-ndjson' ({"frame":"<base64>"} lines, for 'etwutils realtime --format relay-ndjson'). The format is never guessed. [default: binary]

options.name: --input
options.description: Read frames from this file instead of standard input.

options.name: --header
options.description: HTTP header as name=value. Repeatable. Credential-like headers require an https endpoint.

options.name: --resource
options.description: OTLP resource attribute as name=value, e.g. service.name=my-host. Repeatable.

options.name: --gzip
options.description: Compress request bodies with gzip. [default: False]

options.name: --batch-bytes
options.description: Send a request once its frames add up to this many bytes. [default: 1048576]

options.name: --flush-ms
options.description: Longest a frame waits for its batch to fill, in milliseconds. [default: 250]

options.name: --queue-frames
options.description: Frames buffered between reading and sending. When full, the producer is slowed down. [default: 1024]

options.name: --max-retries
options.description: Retries of a request after connection failures, timeouts, 408, 429 and 5xx, before giving up. [default: 8]

options.name: --max-frame-bytes
options.description: Largest frame accepted from the input. [default: 1048576]
